title: Bolden's band members and meeting one across the lake at Mandeville
summary: Bolden's trombonist Cornish and other band members, and a recent meeting with one of them heading to a Mandeville job.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else was in this band? Do you remember when you heard him?
Oh, I remember all of them. I forget some of them names, but I know them.
There was a trombonist, Cornish. Was he with him then?
Oh yeah, that was all the band. That's what I kind of saw it out with. There was a trombonist and George, Louis, Louis. Frank Louis.
You mentioned you saw him once across the lake, you said just a few years ago.

Yeah, I see him. I thought he was dead or he quit playing something. He had a case. He knows me. He's like, now he called me first. He said, you think you're? I said, yeah. I said, where you going, Louis? He said, man, I come from playing back there. He said, where you going? I said, I'm going over there by the Tunk. He said, Tunk, what do you want to go play over there? I said, well, we can't see it all hot and cold out here. You go make up with it. We don't know. We play the solan. They might actually play. We play some. We make a couple of dollars, man. And it's warming up all the time. It keeps nice warming up. Which hall was that? At Mandeville?
